responsibility: Declares the catalog of Arm MVE function-shape descriptors used by the builtin builder and resolver. Each extern const function_shape * name identifies a reusable signature and overload pattern—such as unary, binary, load/store, conversion, compare, predicated accumulate, or specialized families like viddup and vshlc—that arm-mve-builtins-base.def entries reference when registering intrinsic groups. The header is thus the interface for MVE shape objects, complementing arm-mve-builtins-shapes.cc’s implementation of parsing, building, checking, and resolution rules.
same_name_distinction: Declares the exported catalog of reusable function_shape descriptors in arm_mve::shapes, such as unary, load, store, viddup, and vshlc. Unlike arm-mve-builtins-shapes.cc, it does not implement parsing, builder, resolver, or checking behavior; it is the header-level interface that base.def entries can reference when naming a shape.
